Netanagri Full Video:
In the Punjab elections, the Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party are pitted against each other. Rahul Gandhi has escalated the conflict by claiming that when CM Bhagwant Mann was an MP, he used to smell of alcohol—asking how such a person could possibly lead the fight against drugs. Meanwhile, the AAP has hit back by calling Rahul 'Pappu'. Meanwhile, 3 AAP MLAs have moved to the BJP. Watch this video to find out who has the upper hand in Punjab.
